The DEMO vault. Open to any account and in depositable, but not the default: name it with `vault: "tlCashPlusUSDC2"`. Its structure is the one Test 2B restores as a sibling.

vaults.name: Tempora Labs Cash Plus USDC (Test 2A)
vaults.warning: TEST VAULT — unproven. It exists to exercise this product, not to hold savings. Deposit only an amount you are fully prepared to lose entirely, and do not move significant funds into it. Show this warning before preparing any deposit.

depositOpen.detail: deposit(1 USDC, 0x…dEaD) from 0x…dEaD reverted 0x068ca9d8 AccessManagedUnauthorized at block 51361109. The AccessManager at 0xD76eadf8451eB94df0eADd8BfB01C66EF3182ECC returns getTargetFunctionRole(vault, deposit) = 800; withdraw and redeem are PUBLIC_ROLE (2^64-1), so an account that holds shares can always leave.

notes: 8-decimal shares against a 6-decimal asset — a share amount is never an asset amount here.

getInstantWithdrawalFuses() returns three fuses (measured at block 51361109), so a withdrawal is served from the vault's liquid balance and then, in fuse order, by unwinding its positions in the same transaction. A withdrawal larger than what those positions can release in-block still reverts; earn_balance reports exitableNow, which simulates the withdrawal rather than reading maxWithdraw.
Deposits need role 800 on the AccessManager. An account without it gets WHITELIST_GATED from earn_status and earn_quote, and this client refuses to build a deposit for it. Withdrawals are public.

Whitelist-gated (role 800 on its AccessManager): not in depositable. Listed so that an admitted account's position can be read and exited; a non-member gets WHITELIST_GATED from earn_status before anything is built.
